body:
- VS Code extension consuming `@viewers/mdx` in a webview (first external consumer → validates portability)
- Standalone web demo at e.g. `viewer.dev` consuming the same packages
- Live reload when underlying file changes
- Edit mode (Monaco or CodeMirror) — gated per-format
- Export loaded folder → single HTML bundle
- Sync bookmarks/tags across Chrome profiles via `chrome.storage.sync`
- Link graph (backlinks between `.md` files + JSON `$ref` graph)
- `.ipynb` renderer
- Diff two files of the same type
- Search inside JSON values, code symbols, CSV cells — not just raw text
